items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We'll check with Handy, he probably knows him, and Tom Alvarez.

ctx.x: A handy from downtown. John Handy, sure. John Handy, sure. John Handy, yeah. I must have had a bass player or a piano player. Yeah, they had a bass player, I just remember. Jake. Jake, huh? Yeah, probably they called Jake. Mm-hmm.
We'll check with Handy, he probably knows him, and Tom Alvarez. Yeah, yeah. Who did George Washington play with too? George Washington? Mm-hmm. George Washington.
George Washington played with Bate Petit.
